notes: Gen 2 singles: Parasect's Spore puts Snorlax to sleep; Snorlax's Sleep Talk calls Metronome, which calls a multi-hit move. pokecrystal's `BattleCommand_EndLoop` checks no sleep, so every hit lands; Showdown's gen2 loop reads Metronome's `sleepUsable` (none) and stops before the first hit, which the oracle patches (issues.md I203, DESIGN.md R-M8-186)
